name: Meelni Engagement & Retention Features
description: Feature-focused roadmap to drive user engagement and retention. Organized around user value: see progress, stay motivated, keep practicing.

themes.name: See Your Progress
themes.description: Help users understand how they're improving over time

themes.name: Stay Motivated
themes.description: Gamification, streaks, and achievements to keep users coming back

themes.name: Stay Connected
themes.description: Notifications and reminders to maintain engagement

userStories.title: Fix analytics stats showing blank/NaN values
userStories.description: Dashboard stats cards show blank total sessions, '/ out of 10' for avg score, and 'm' for total time
acceptanceCriteria: Total sessions shows actual count (not blank)
Average score shows number before '/ out of 10'
Total time shows number before 'm'
Handle edge case of zero sessions gracefully
npm run typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Fixed falsy value checks - changed from truthy checks to explicit null/undefined checks to handle 0 values correctly
userStories.userValue: Users can see their actual stats

userStories.title: Fix chart colors invisible on dark theme
userStories.description: Charts show black lines/text on black background - score trend, time investment, competency breakdown all invisible
acceptanceCriteria: Score trend chart lines visible (use brand colors)
Time investment bar chart bars visible
Competency breakdown radar has visible text and polygon
Chart backgrounds use appropriate theme colors
All charts work in both light and dark modes
npm run typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Fixed chart colors by ensuring stroke and fill attributes use theme-aware CSS variables (hsl(var(--border)), hsl(var(--muted-foreground)))
userStories.userValue: Users can actually see their progress charts

userStories.title: Fix competency breakdown showing 0% with no data
userStories.description: Competency radar shows 0% and 'Strongest: Structure' even when user has sessions with scores
acceptanceCriteria: Radar chart displays actual scores from feedback

Handle missing feedback gracefully (show message, not 0%)
Percentages calculated correctly from dimension scores
npm run typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Fixed by including dimension scores in session query and filtering sessions with null scores in aggregation logic
userStories.userValue: Users see their real competency breakdown

userStories.title: Fix NaN percentage in interview type distribution
